description: This Java source file defines an enum 'SqlOperator' that encapsulates various SQL operators, their formatting logic, and validation methods for use within the Fineract project.

classes.name: SqlOperator
classes.description: An enum representing various SQL operators with methods for formatting SQL snippets and validating parameters.

methods.name: isDefault
methods.description: Checks if the current operator is the default (EQ).

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Returns the default SQL operator, which is EQ (=).

methods.name: isListType
methods.description: Indicates if the operator expects a list of values (e.g., IN, NOT IN).

methods.name: formatSql
methods.description: Formats an SQL fragment using the provided SQL generator, column type, definition, alias, and values.

methods.name: formatImpl
methods.description: Internal method to generate SQL string based on operator and values.

methods.name: formatNamedParam
methods.description: Creates a named parameter SQL fragment for the operator.

methods.name: formatNamedParamImpl
methods.description: Internal method to generate named parameter SQL string.

methods.name: formatPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a placeholder-based SQL fragment for the operator.

methods.name: formatPlaceholder
methods.description: Overloaded method to specify custom placeholder string.

methods.name: formatPlaceholderImpl
methods.description: Internal method to generate placeholder SQL string.

methods.name: validateValues
methods.description: Validates the provided values against the operator's expected parameter count.

methods.name: validateParamCount
methods.description: Validates that the number of parameters matches the operator's expected count.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Returns the SqlOperator enum constant matching the provided name, case-insensitive.
